**Answer.** Reconstructing the Flite Test Mighty Mini Corsair MKR2 reproduces all three published targets inside specification (@fig-corsair-three-view, @fig-target-errors). Wing span lands at [`{python} f"{span*1e3:.1f}"` mm]{.key} (target `{python} f"{TARGET_SPAN*1e3:.0f}"` mm, `{python} f"{abs(span_err)*100:.2f}"` % error against [`{python} f"{TOL_SPAN*100:.0f}"` %]{.key} tolerance). Dry airframe weight with flight electronics totals [`{python} f"{mass*1e3:.1f}"` g]{.key} (target `{python} f"{TARGET_DRY_WEIGHT*1e3:.0f}"` g, `{python} f"{abs(mass_err)*100:.2f}"` % error against [`{python} f"{TOL_DRY_WEIGHT*100:.0f}"` %]{.key}). Longitudinal center of gravity sits [`{python} f"{cg_x*1e3:.1f}"` mm]{.key} aft of the root leading edge (target `{python} f"{TARGET_CG_X*1e3:.0f}"` mm, [`{python} f"{abs(cg_err)*100:.1f}"` %]{.key} error against [`{python} f"{TOL_CG_X*100:.0f}"` %]{.key}). The worst discrepancy is `{python} f"{max_err*100:.1f}"` %.

```{python}
#| label: fig-target-errors
#| fig-cap: "Reconstructed aircraft metric errors compared to target specification tolerances."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

names = ["Wing span\n(737 mm)", "Dry weight\n(270 g)", "CG position\n(44 mm)"]
errors = [abs(span_err) * 100, abs(mass_err) * 100, abs(cg_err) * 100]
tolerances = [TOL_SPAN * 100, TOL_DRY_WEIGHT * 100, TOL_CG_X * 100]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 2.5))
y_pos = range(len(names))

ax.barh([y + 0.18 for y in y_pos], tolerances, height=0.32, color="#5c6670", alpha=0.35, label="Tolerance (±%)")
ax.barh([y - 0.18 for y in y_pos], errors, height=0.32, color="#14655c", label="Model error (%)")

ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax.set_yticklabels(names)
ax.set_xlabel("Discrepancy / Allowance (%)")
ax.set_xlim(0, 12)
ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc="lower right")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
